resources.string: Live Rocket Tracker wallpaper — entertainment only. Tracks when launches happen so you can watch on YouTube or your phone. Not real-time telemetry from rocket companies.
Empty desk page for the eight HUD buttons. Wallpaper shows through.
Entertainment purposes only. Rocket companies do not share real-time telemetry. This wallpaper tracks when launches happen so you can watch on YouTube or your phone.

We sync launches as close to real time as public sources allow, but no rocket company provides exact live telemetry. Delays and holds can make this display differ from the actual launch — confirm with the official stream.
